diff_scope.method: code-object comparison against __pycache__/selftest_c2p0_slot0_neg_cfg_sweep_full.cpython-312.pyc (compiled 2026-08-30T15:10:25Z from the 11233-byte source)
diff_scope.change: Both tests now wrap their driver call in mock.patch.object(driver, 'storage_gate', return_value=10**12), making the no-GPU fixtures hermetic against the host filesystem's free space instead of reading the real statvfs of a tempdir.

superseded_receipts.reason: notification_receipts.deliver_required treats contract_sha256 as an immutable per-(experiment_id,event) binding; re-seating 029 under the amended contract would fail closed on the pre-amendment receipts and silently re-hold the job. The originals are retained unmodified for audit.

notification.reason: Operator explicitly asked for no further held-status Discord messages. This amendment emits no notification event; the next Discord message for this experiment will be the seat_attempt on re-seat and then its terminal event.

known_issue_not_changed.seat_notifications_are_labelled_held: gpu_queue/p2_host.sh calls `notify held "p2-seat-<job>"` before seat_and_wait because notify_experiment_webhook.py only accepts (success|failure|interrupted|held|test). Every normal job seating therefore reaches Discord as a held-status message. Left unchanged: the notifier is a hash-pinned input of this and other live contracts.
